items.title: Willie J. Humphrey and Willie E. Humphrey Interview, 1959-03-15
items.q: The interviewee only responds with 'Yeah.' to the interviewer's story about Lawrence Stewart; no personal interaction or relationship is described by the interviewee.

ctx.x: Yes, maybe we could make a copy of this by making another photograph of this with a new negative, then we could get a new print of it, too. You could, eh? Mm-hmm. And they have a way of photographing the photograph. Yeah. And reproducing it. It won't be too clear, but at least it'll show it.

Yeah, well I had one of, I made, let's see, we played that World Series 1919, and Lawrence Stewart, I lost my copy, and Lawrence Stewart, he gave me a little postcard thing, you know? Yes, that's all. And he reproduced it. Yeah. He had it reproduced. Yeah. I still have it, and I have this one. I kept up with this one, but the other I couldn't. I misplaced it. Yeah.
